description: Every edge touching the given work in either direction, each tagged asserted|inferred with attribution and provenance. Use when a user asks 'what is known about this paper's citations' or wants the whole neighbourhood in one call. Paged.

asserted_only.description: If true, restrict to human-signed (asserted) edges. If false (default), return both asserted and machine-inferred edges.

identifier.description: DOI, arXiv id, OpenAlex id, or internal claim id

limit.description: Maximum edges to return per tier (default 100, max 1000). Well-cited works have thousands; the response reports has_more and inferred_total so you can tell a page from the whole answer.

offset.description: How many edges to skip, for paging. Advance by the LIMIT you asked for, not by the number of results you got back — duplicates are removed after the window is taken, so a page can return fewer rows than it consumed. Keep going while has_more is true.

name: edges_about
title: Edges about
